_comment: FICTIONAL example for a made-up 'Lantern Library' app (web + mobile monorepo). It documents the catalogue shape and is the test fixture for smoke-journeys.py. An install's real catalogue lives beside its standing instructions as journeys.json, never here.

excludePaths.reason: contributor notes; never built, served or shipped
lint rule sources; CI is the watcher and nothing a user runs loads them

journeys.title: Check a book out at the loan desk
journeys.proves: a librarian can lend an available copy and the loan survives a reload
steps: Sign in as the librarian seat and open the loan desk.
Search for the seeded title and pick the copy marked available.
Choose the seeded borrower, pick a loan period from the period menu, and confirm.
Reload the page and open the borrower's card.
journeys.endState: the borrower's card lists the loan with the chosen period after a reload, and the copy shows as on loan
journeys.seed: one available copy titled QA-<runId>-<side>-atlas and one borrower QA-<runId>-<side>-reader, created by the walk
journeys.restore: return the copy, then delete the QA-<runId>-<side>-* title and borrower

journeys.title: A branch librarian cannot read another branch's fines
journeys.proves: if this were broken, one branch would read another branch's borrower fines
steps: With the north-branch seat's token, request the south branch's fines list.
With the south-branch seat's token, request the north branch's fines list.
journeys.endState: both requests are refused with 403 and return no fine rows

journeys.title: Return a book by scanning it in the mobile app
journeys.proves: a borrower can return a loan from the phone camera flow
steps: Open the Loans tab and tap Return on the seeded loan.
Scan the barcode printed in the packet.
journeys.endState: the loan leaves the Loans tab and the web desk shows the copy as available
journeys.seed: one open loan for the qa-reader seat on a copy named QA-<runId>-<side>-scan
